description: This file defines the `DeviceHandler` class responsible for gathering and providing various device-related information such as battery status, device info, permissions, and health metrics. It interacts with Android system services to collect data and constructs JSON payloads to represent the device's current state.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for collecting device status, info, permissions, and health metrics, and generating corresponding JSON payloads.

classes.name: BatterySnapshot
classes.description: Data class that holds a snapshot of battery status, plugged state, level fraction, and temperature.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representing the current battery, thermal, storage, and network status of the device.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with device model, manufacturer, system version, app version, and locale.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Returns a JSON string detailing the current permissions status for various device features.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with device health metrics like memory pressure, battery state, and power modes.

methods.name: statusPayloadJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string encapsulating battery, thermal, storage, network, and uptime data.

methods.name: infoPayloadJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string containing device identification and localization info.

methods.name: permissionsPayloadJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the various permissions and capabilities of the device.

methods.name: healthPayloadJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string with device health data such as memory info, battery status, and power modes.

methods.name: readBatterySnapshot
methods.description: Reads the current battery status, level, temperature, and plugged state from system intents.

methods.name: batteryLevelFraction
methods.description: Calculates the battery level as a fraction based on intent extras.

methods.name: mapBatteryState
methods.description: Maps battery status codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: mapChargingType
methods.description: Maps plugged status codes to human-readable charging types.

methods.name: mapThermalState
methods.description: Determines thermal status from PowerManager thermal statuses.

methods.name: mapNetworkStatus
methods.description: Maps NetworkCapabilities to network satisfaction states.

methods.name: permissionStateJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON object representing permission status.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has a specific permission.

methods.name: mapMemoryPressure
methods.description: Determines memory pressure level based on total and available memory.

methods.name: networkInterfacesJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON array of network interface types based on NetworkCapabilities.
